description: This Kotlin source file defines several composable UI components for rendering chat messages in an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It includes components for chat bubbles, message content display, typing indicators, tool call indicators, and code blocks, with styling based on message roles.

classes.name: ChatBubbleStyle
classes.description: Data class encapsulating styling properties for chat bubbles, including alignment, background color, border color, and role label color.

methods.name: ChatMessageBubble
methods.description: Main composable function that renders a chat message bubble based on the message's role and content.

methods.name: ChatBubbleContainer
methods.description: Container composable for chat bubbles, handling layout and styling.

methods.name: ChatMessageBody
methods.description: Displays the message content, handling text and image parts.

methods.name: ChatTypingIndicatorBubble
methods.description: Displays a typing indicator bubble with animation dots.

methods.name: ChatPendingToolsBubble
methods.description: Displays a bubble indicating running tools with their details.

methods.name: ChatStreamingAssistantBubble
methods.description: Displays a live assistant message bubble, styled distinctly.

methods.name: bubbleStyle
methods.description: Determines bubble style based on message role.

methods.name: roleLabel
methods.description: Provides display label based on role string.

methods.name: ChatBase64Image
methods.description: Displays an image decoded from base64 content.

methods.name: DotPulse
methods.description: Animated pulsing dots for typing indicator.

methods.name: PulseDot
methods.description: Single animated dot used in the pulsing indicator.

methods.name: ChatCodeBlock
methods.description: Displays formatted code snippets with optional language label.
